Question 4
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the line integral of the function f(x,y)=x2−y, traversed along the line segment from (0,2) to (3,1)?

a
2∫01(t2+t−2)dt
b
10∫01(t2−t+2)dt
c
10∫01(9t2+t−2)dt
d
2∫01(t2−t+2)dt
e
10∫01(9t2+t−2)dt
